topic: Projectile Motion: Horizontal and Vertical Components
key_concepts: Projectile motion is motion of an object given an initial velocity and acted on by gravity
A projectile follows a curved path called a trajectory
Gravity is a downward natural force that causes objects to fall toward Earth
Acceleration due to gravity is -9.8 m/s² directed downward
Projectile motion combines independent horizontal and vertical motions
Horizontally launched projectiles follow a curved path from an elevated position to the gr
Angle-launched projectiles rise to a peak then fall in a symmetrical parabolic path
An object dropped from rest has an initial velocity of 0 m/s
A vertically projected object has zero velocity at the peak of its trajectory
Vertical velocity changes continuously due to gravity
Horizontal velocity of a projectile remains constant
Kinematic equations can be applied separately to horizontal and vertical motion
